string-array.item: Sony hFT-Transformer (ISMIR 2023). Accurate for solo piano, with velocity and live streaming while you record.
MuScriptor medium by Kyutai and Mirelo (2026). A 307M-parameter transformer that writes notes directly and also handles other instruments. Highest accuracy, but slow on a phone; velocities are fixed.
